analysis:
Examined all supplied patches, source excerpts and file metadata. scripts/resolve-provider-release.sh head:18-36 now admits master pushes only for staging and dev pushes only for dev, rejecting other branch/environment combinations. Head:55-69 prevents nonvalidation dev publication outside a dev push and retains production's tag requirement. Head:80-109 adds the dev.branch.N suffix, retains version validation before workflow outputs, and keeps validation builds unpublished. No concrete bypass or security regression is established in this script.

scripts/test-provider-identity.py changes only a comment at head:125; its identity-isolation and marker assertions remain unchanged. The supplied scripts/test-provider-release-pipeline.py patch updates lane/concurrency assertions and adds final archived-app signature and source-gate assertions at head:316-354. These tests express expected controls but do not establish the actual workflow implementation or execution.

Relevant contracts are release credentials and trusted binary registration (A-005/A-011), durable qualification and signed-code identity (A-017, T-013, T-034, T-054), and separation of signed artifacts from serving permission (TB-011/T-052). No inference, encryption, plaintext handling, billing, cache, native-runtime or local-helper behavior changes are visible here.

Integration must verify the actual release-provider.yml and release-dev-branch.yml changes together with provider-release-resume.py's source gate: dev source admission must remain environment-bound and reviewed workflow source must precede credential access. Also verify that final signature checks and dev signing/publication preserve environment isolation and do not imply qualification. These implementations are not supplied; tests alone cannot settle the newly admitted dev-branch release trust contract. No deployment or branch-protection assumptions were made.
